about: JR and King when the Royal Rumble's camera is behind them (it pulls back for six; their table often broken, so they stand): drawn solid, in front, as the game draws its own table then -- and drawn right (in the user's screenshots King's head was a black block). Pictures are taken whenever the camera is behind them and King is drawn (shots *_WHEN).

expect.name: the Rumble ran
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 300

expect.name: the camera went behind them (the case tested)
JR and King are always drawn (only the camera inside a head hides one)
expect.check: not (mode == -2 and ann_draw != 0xFFFF) or (ann_draw & 0x8080) == 0 or eye_z < -612

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
